banner.title: samba
banner.tagline: Serves the Hermes shares to the Mac over SMB3, forcing every file to the agent's uid and gid 10000.

explainer.title: One account, one identity, two shares

steps.title: Password
steps.text: The ExternalSecret renders the SMB password as a file at /run/secrets/pass, so the credential never enters the container environment.
steps.scene: a sealed key handed over in a locked box

steps.title: Identity
steps.text: The entrypoint creates the hermes account at uid and gid 10000, and smb.conf forces every session to that identity.
steps.scene: a plain ID badge on a lanyard, no text

steps.title: Shares
steps.text: [xml] exports /shared and [files] exports /files, both on RWX CephFS claims, behind one LoadBalancer address on the LAN.
steps.scene: two plain folders behind one gate, no text

steps.title: Modes
steps.text: An init container chowns both roots and sets setgid 2770. A postStart hook sets it again once smbd is up, because the entrypoint strips it.
steps.scene: a permission seal pressed onto a folder

steps.title: Finder
steps.text: SMB3 only on port 445. vfs_fruit keeps metadata in xattrs, and NFS ACLs are off, so Finder cannot change the owner back.
steps.scene: a laptop window pointing at a shared drive

art.about: an SMB file server that forces every session to one service identity and exports two shares
